title: Add type stubs for google_auth_oauthlib when a working package becomes available
description: The only stubs package on PyPI for google_auth_oauthlib (google-auth-oauthlib-stubs) is broken — it installs files to a wrong directory (tool/__init__.pyi instead of google_auth_oauthlib/*.pyi). A mypy override in puppeteer/pyproject.toml suppresses import-untyped errors for google_auth_oauthlib.* as a workaround. When upstream ships py.typed or a working stubs package appears, remove the override and add the stubs dependency.
